paragraphs: LEDVANCE catalogues lighting hardware, and its luminaire range is split between professional luminaires and residential luminaires. The type filters on that page list area and street light, flood light, high bay, linear luminaires and trunking systems. Individual entries cover indoor and outdoor fittings, among them surface mounted luminaires with GU10 socket and a wall luminaire with a sensor option.

A second product page lists light management components, grouped as VIVARES components by LEDVANCE, SMART+ components and components by Osram. Those components include Zigbee couplers and sensors, DALI-2 interfaces for standard lighting switches, and controllers for wired IOT light management systems. The same page lists luminaires with a Zigbee driver, including downlight luminaires with aluminum housing.

The home page groups the portfolio as professional lighting, lighting for your home and renewable energy. Beside the lighting ranges it points to photovoltaic panels, inverters and a battery storage system.

quote.text: LEDVANCE provides professional services for joint projects.
